# Florida South Construction

> General contractor in Naples, Florida, for homes and businesses in Lee and Collier counties: maintenance and home repair, remodeling and renovation, custom cabinetry, restoration after natural disasters, and new construction. Led by its president, Judson White. Florida license CGC1515532, Certified General Contractor, held by Judson Gregory White for Florida South Construction, Inc.; licensed since June 2, 2008, current and active through August 31, 2028 (Florida Department of Business and Professional Regulation). Office at 1575 Pine Ridge Rd., Suite 10, Naples, FL 34109. Phone (239) 449-4477; fax (239) 449-4470; email Jwhite@floridasouth.us.

## What they do

- [Maintenance and home repair](https://floridasouth.us/#work): no job is too small. They take on a homeowner's to-do list and the minor repairs on it, from patching holes to replacing fixtures.
- [Remodeling and renovation](https://floridasouth.us/#work): complete renovations for homes and businesses; kitchen and bathroom remodels, countertops (granite or tile), cabinets and custom cabinetry, flooring, painting, crown molding, framing, decks and porches, sunrooms, additions; restoration after natural disasters. Artistic renovations too: a surf shack remodel, a tropical bar, coastal-style wood weathered on request.
- [New construction](https://floridasouth.us/#work): new houses, from the block walls to the white eaves.

## Two houses they built

- [The raised house](https://floridasouth.us/#houses): photographed in 2015. Pale blue-green lap siding, stucco columns, white eaves, Bahama shutters and a metal roof, with the garages on the ground floor. Their job sign reads "Another Quality Home".
- [The block house in the pines](https://floridasouth.us/#houses): photographed in 2016, before the drywall. Concrete block walls, wood roof trusses and covered porches; the framing, ducts, wiring and plumbing inside.

## Who they are

- [Judson White, president](https://floridasouth.us/#judson): the president of Florida South Construction and the general contractor named on its state license. Their commitments: an eye for detail ("we don't consider a job complete until it is perfect"); respect for your home, your family and your privacy, with as little disruption as possible; a business built on relationships, with references on request.
- [State license](https://www.myfloridalicense.com/wl11.asp?mode=1&SID=&brd=&typ=&search=LicNbr): search for CGC1515532 on the Florida DBPR site.
